item.title: Naeba: World-Class Skiing & Home of Fuji Rock Festival — Guide
item.description: Naeba Ski Resort is one of Japan’s largest and most established ski areas, its expansive network of slopes and reliable snowfall drawing skiers and snowboarders of all levels each winter. Each July, the same mountain venue transforms entirely for Fuji Rock Festival, Japan’s largest and longest-running outdoor music festival, when tens of thousands of fans camp and hike across the resort’s forested slopes to see international and Japanese acts across multiple stages set amid the natural landscape.
